verdict.rationale: RustDesk's own docs list audit logs as a Server Pro feature, alongside a web console and management API (rustdesk-docs-12), and the pricing page also lists "Audit log" (rustdesk-docs-15), so this is a first-party capability limited to the paid tier. The evidence never says what the log records (who, which machine, when) or how it can be exported, so it covers only part of the story. Missing for 10: documented connection-log contents (user, target device, timestamps), export capability for audit, availability beyond paid Server Pro, independent/hands-on corroboration.
